article.headline: Saint Joseph's takes down Loyola Chicago 85-64
article.description: — Austin Williford had 17 points and 10 rebounds, and Saint Joseph's beat Loyola Chicago 85-64 on Tuesday night.
article.linkText: Saint Joseph's takes down Loyola Chicago 85-64

categories.description: Saint Joseph's Hawks @ Loyola Chicago Ramblers

event.description: Saint Joseph's Hawks @ Loyola Chicago Ramblers

keywords: Saint Joseph's Hawks @ Loyola Chicago Ramblers
article.story: CHICAGO -- — Austin Williford had 17 points and 10 rebounds, and Saint Joseph's beat Loyola Chicago 85-64 on Tuesday night. Jaiden Glover added 16 points for the Hawks (13-8, 5-3 Atlantic 10 Conference). Derek Simpson finished with 15 points. The Ramblers (5-17, 1-8) were led by Joshua Ola-Joseph, who recorded 13 points and seven rebounds. Deywilk Tavarez added 12 points for Loyola Chicago. Xavier Amos also had 11 points. The loss is the eighth in a row for the Ramblers. Glover scored 14 points and the Hawks led 51-24 at halftime. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
